diff --git a/index.mjs b/index.mjs
index 4bff70b..49b5415 100644
--- a/index.mjs
+++ b/index.mjs
@@ -1 +1 @@
-export { slugify } from './lib/slug.mjs'
+export { slugify, uniqueSlug } from './lib/slug.mjs'
diff --git a/lib/slug.mjs b/lib/slug.mjs
index 30c170b..0635b44 100644
--- a/lib/slug.mjs
+++ b/lib/slug.mjs
@@ -1,3 +1,26 @@
+const SEPARATOR = '-'
+const COMBINING_MARKS = /[\u0300-\u036f]/g
+const NON_SLUG_CHARS = /[^a-z0-9]+/g
+const EDGE_SEPARATORS = /^-+|-+$/g
+
 export function slugify(input) {
-  throw new Error('slugify is not implemented yet')
+  if (input == null) return ''
+  const normalized = String(input)
+    .normalize('NFD')
+    .replace(COMBINING_MARKS, '')
+    .toLowerCase()
+  return normalized
+    .replace(NON_SLUG_CHARS, SEPARATOR)
+    .replace(EDGE_SEPARATORS, '')
+}
+
+export function uniqueSlug(input, taken = []) {
+  const base = slugify(input) || 'item'
+  const used = taken instanceof Set ? taken : new Set(taken)
+  if (!used.has(base)) return base
+  let suffix = 2
+  while (used.has(`${base}-${suffix}`)) {
+    suffix += 1
+  }
+  return `${base}-${suffix}`
 }

artifacts.content:
All 4 tests pass (`node --test`: 4 pass, 0 fail).

What I implemented:

- `lib/slug.mjs`
  - `slugify(input)`: normalizes to NFD and strips combining marks (accent removal → `Héllo` → `hello`), lowercases, replaces any run of non-alphanumeric characters with `-` (punctuation and repeated/leading/trailing separators collapse naturally → `a --  b` → `a-b`), and returns `''` for nullish input.
  - `uniqueSlug(input, taken)`: slugifies the base, returns it when unused, otherwise walks `-2`, `-3`, … until it finds a free suffix.
- `index.mjs`: added the missing `uniqueSlug` export (the test imports it from `./index.mjs`, so it failed at import before).
